role: Blog snapshot scalar edits, phase and comment moderation, attachment groups
known_patches: Neutral halo env_id and integer internal seed ids; synthetic User 1
Runtime-supported password alias and textual account_name session for name-based source identity guards
limitations: All 112 original tools are retained; only twelve explicitly listed write tools are certified.
post_updatecontent edits the named Snapshot row. No guard verifies that snapshotName belongs to the supplied Post; use known matching identities.
post_publish/unpublish only change status_phase; they do not set spec_publish, advance head/release snapshots or publish a complete rendered document.
post_draft inserts only Post metadata, dropping raw/content rather than creating a linked Snapshot. post_update inserts a Snapshot but does not update Post title/head references.
comment_delete only sets deletion_timestamp and post_recycle marks spec_deleted; lists do not automatically hide these rows.
Many source writes lack authentication/role guards. Original guards are preserved with name/id normalization; no complete RBAC claim is made. Attachment interfaces store metadata, not binary bytes.

snapshot_listbypost uses substring matching on the serialized subject reference, because the original read filter cannot address JSON subfields; overlapping metadata names can match multiple subjects.
